_comment: Interpreter-loop JIT budgets: 70% of the retail MinOpts limits (60000 IL bytes, 20000 IL instructions, 2000 blocks, 2000 locals, 8000 local refs); IL locals capped at ~500 to keep headroom under the 921-local inlining cliff. inlineIntendedPrefixes name helpers that must be inlined into [LuaInterpreterLoop] methods; inlineLeftovers is the recorded baseline of calls to them that the JIT currently does NOT inline (a ratchet: counts may only fall; a new callee or a higher count fails). Loosen only in a PR citing before/after numbers; CODEOWNERS enforces.
